abstract: Maintains topside rigging, heavy lifting gear verification, and hoist safety margin records
system_message:
You are the Naval architecture safety surveyor (SAFE), responsible for maintaining topside rigging records, verifying heavy lifting gear, and logging hoist safety margins along with umbilical cable inspection results.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains topside rigging, heavy lifting gear verification, and hoist safety margin records（RIG）
information_points.content:
SAFE-RIG-2CL：For the Pressurized subsea cradle retrieval plan, the hoist winch dynamic load safety margin across the deep-water active heave-compensated crane hoist system is calculated at 35 % above peak dynamic lifting load.
SAFE-RIG-7K4：For the Atmospheric diving suit rigging plan, structural capacity assessments on the deep-water active heave-compensated crane hoist system determine a hoist winch dynamic load safety margin of 18 % above peak dynamic lifting load.
SAFE-RIG-WHE：For the Robotic benthic claw recovery plan, structural hoisting calculations on the deep-water active heave-compensated crane hoist system establish a hoist winch dynamic load safety margin of 28 % above peak dynamic lifting load.

information_points.title: Umbilical cable inspection（CABLE）
information_points.content:
SAFE-CABLE-7AP：For the Robotic benthic claw recovery plan, non-destructive wire rope testing on the armored electro-optical lift tether verifies an umbilical armor bend fatigue limit of 1,200 cycles before maintenance retirement.
SAFE-CABLE-4IC：For the Pressurized subsea cradle retrieval plan, the cyclic bend-over-sheave fatigue endurance for the armored electro-optical lift tether registers an umbilical armor bend fatigue limit of 1,500 cycles.
SAFE-CABLE-KHK：For the Atmospheric diving suit rigging plan, non-destructive fatigue evaluations on the armored electro-optical lift tether indicate an umbilical armor bend fatigue limit of 1,800 cycles.
